q.act1.q01: Let's get you ashore. Merge those Baby Bananas into a Banana Bud.
q.act1.q02: You need to eat before you build. Bring me a Ripe Banana.
q.act1.q03: The grass is as tall as I am. Clear 3 Tall Grass.
q.act1.q04: The dock needs fiber and logs. Driftwood on the beach will do: one Fiber Tuft and one Long Log.
q.act1.q05: Repair the dock. Beni deserves a proper landing.
q.act1.q06: Grandma's cottage is still standing, barely. Clear 8 obstacles around it.
q.act1.q07: A letter under the floorboards! The floor needs one good Cut Log first.
q.act1.q08: A roof first, questions later. One Cut Log and a nail.
q.act1.q09: Show me you can handle tools. Make a Hoe.
q.act1.q10: The farmstead is calling. Reach level 3 and open the way.
q.act1.q11: Bring coconuts for the roof glue.
q.act1.q12: The lumber yard has been a swamp for years. Build it!
q.act1.q13: The cottage needs a roof before it needs a name.
q.act1.q14: Make me a Machete. Hard brush deserves a sharper answer.
q.act1.q15: The letter speaks of six amulets. Bring me coconuts and I will tell you the tale.
q.act1.q16: I once caught a fish bigger than this boat. Almost.
q.act1.q17: Look at it all. Reach level 4.
q.act1.q18: The island is waking up, I can feel it.
q.act1.q20: A proper gate: a hinge, two Cut Logs, patience.
q.act1.q21: Back in my day, we did this with one hand tied.
q.act1.q23: The ferry has seen better days. Make her proud: two Fiber Stalks for the lines.
q.act1.q24: Grandma never made it look this hard.
q.act1.q25: I am not soft. I just have allergies. To sentiment.
q.act1.q26: Level 5. The meadow beyond the farm is waiting.
q.act1.q27: I once caught a fish bigger than this boat. Almost.
q.act1.q28: Every great work needs one great day. Logs, coconut and banana: bring me all three.
q.act2.q01: Grandma wrote about a meadow with a market row. Let us open it.
q.act2.q02: You have hands. The meadow needs them. Clear 8 obstacles.
q.act2.q03: A good build starts with good materials.
q.act2.q04: If I can fix a roof, I can fix anything.
q.act2.q06: Hens before hammers. Build the Hen House.
q.act2.q09: I know a remedy for most things. Not for hurry.
q.act2.q10: An Orange Blossom, please. For the healing tea. It also smells nice.
q.act2.q12: Okay, Elena. Show me what you would do.
q.act2.q13: A market needs a stall. Build the Market Stall.
q.act2.q14: Hm. Almost. Bring me a better one.
q.act2.q15: That is not crooked. That is character. Fine, I will fix it.
q.act2.q16: My grandmother knew yours. Bring me some mint and I will tell you how.
q.act2.q17: Bring me something green and I will do the rest.
q.act2.q18: The garden always knows what it needs.
q.act2.q19: Level 8 and an amulet in hand. Stonebrook is next.
q.act2.q20: Bring me something green and I will do the rest.
q.act2.q21: Open Stonebrook. The creek is singing.
q.act2.q22: Is that a stove? A kitchen! Build me a Hearth, bambino.
q.act2.q23: I know a remedy for most things. Not for hurry.
q.act2.q24: One thing at a time. I can do this.
q.act2.q25: Stone for the foundations. Build the Quarry.
q.act2.q26: Stand up straight! Cooking is a sport!
q.act2.q27: The island is waking up, I can feel it.
q.act2.q28: A Green Bowl. Crisp outside, wholesome inside. Make one.
q.act2.q30: Grandma never made it look this hard.

q.act2.q32: Measure twice. Cut once. Deliver once.
q.act2.q33: A good build starts with good materials.

q.act2.q35: If I can fix a roof, I can fix anything.

q.act4.q22: Your grandmother would have laughed at this mess. Fondly.
q.act4.q23: Repair the Shrine. Blue crystals, gently, and a carved amulet.
q.act4.q24: It is older than it looks. I am older than I look. Do not ask.

ui.title: Tropical Merge
ui.noSpace: No space. Merge, store or sell!
res.beni.arrive: Welcome to Isla Solana, kiddo. She's seen better days. So have I.
res.mateo.arrive: I heard hammering. Thought it was a woodpecker. Turns out it's you.
res.tala.arrive: The herbs here have been lonely. They will be glad of company.
res.rosa.arrive: Who left this kitchen in such a state? Never mind. I will fix it.
res.kai.arrive: I am Kai! I know every shell on this island. Well, almost.
res.victor.arrive: Victor Crane. I have an offer for the bay. Do not look at me like that.
res.okoye.arrive: Dr. Okoye. I treat animals. Goats, mostly. And their opinions.
res.lena.arrive: Oh! A person! Quick, mind that stone, it is a thousand years old.
